tool.name: authz_matrix_check
tool.description:
Authorization-matrix prober. For each (role × endpoint) cell, dispatch the same request as that role and compare outcomes. Detects unauthenticated bypass and vertical privilege escalation.
The classical pen-test approach to authorization. Today the agent fragments this across many sessions; gaps are inevitable. This tool turns it into one deterministic call.
Compose with: - `bfs_crawl` (the endpoint inventory) — pass its `endpoints` field verbatim - Cluster-A safety middleware — auth-injection on top of role headers, exclude-path, rate-limit; all applied automatically per request
Roles: Each role is `{name, headers, privilege?}` where `headers` is the role's auth headers (Cookie/Authorization/X-API-Key/etc.). The headers cross only into the proxy's request — they are NEVER logged in events.jsonl, finding bodies, or tool outputs. Only the role *name* (which is an operator-chosen label) appears in finding evidence.
Convention: include an `unauth` role with empty `headers: {}` to detect anonymous bypass. Include 2+ authenticated roles with distinct `privilege` values (typically 50 for `user` and 100 for `admin`) to detect vertical privilege escalation on admin-shaped paths.
Findings: - **High** (CWE-862, missing_authorization) — `unauth` role gets the same response signature (status + body length) as ANY authenticated role on the same endpoint. - **High** (CWE-285, improper_authorization) — lower-privilege role gets the same response as higher-privilege role on an admin-shaped path (default heuristics: /admin, /internal, /private, /manage, /superuser, /staff, /_admin, /sudo, /root — override via `admin_path_patterns`).
`verification_status=needs_review` on every finding because the heuristic relies on response-signature equality; the agent should fetch the underlying responses to verify before treating the finding as confirmed.

parameter.name: endpoints
parameter.description: JSON-encoded list of endpoints. Accepts either bfs_crawl's `[{url, method, ...}]` shape verbatim or a flat URL list (implicit method=GET). Duplicates removed.

parameter.name: roles
parameter.description: JSON-encoded list of roles. Each: `{name: str, headers: dict, privilege?: int}`. `name` is the operator-chosen label that appears in findings. `headers` is the role's auth header set (NEVER logged). `privilege` is optional integer (default 50 for named roles, 0 for `unauth`/`anonymous`/`anon`). Roles are probed in privilege order, lowest first.

parameter.name: max_cells
parameter.description: Hard cap on (role × endpoint) cells probed. Default 200, hard-capped at 2000. Bounds total request count + protects rate-limit budget.

parameter.name: admin_path_patterns
parameter.description: Comma-separated regex list overriding the default admin-path heuristics. Example: `/api/v1/admin/.*,/internal/.*`. Used only for vertical priv-esc detection — `unauth_bypass` detection runs against every endpoint regardless.

returns.description: {success, endpoints_count, roles, cells: [{role, url, method, status, body_length, signature, skipped?, error?}], stats}. Findings are emitted as side effects via the tracer (see `verification_status` and `category` fields on each finding).
